description: This file defines the implementation of the BusinessEventNotifierService in the Fineract project. It handles the registration and notification of business events, manages external event posting, and integrates with transaction lifecycle to ensure proper event handling and posting.

classes.name: BusinessEventNotifierServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BusinessEventNotifierService interface, managing event notifications and external posting in Fineract.

classes.name: BusinessEventWithContext
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating a BusinessEvent along with its FineractContext, used for transactional event handling.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the service, logging whether external event posting is enabled.

methods.name: notifyPreBusinessEvent
methods.description: Notifies registered listeners before a business event is processed.

methods.name: addPreBusinessEventListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for pre-business events of a specific type.

methods.name: notifyPostBusinessEvent
methods.description: Notifies registered listeners after a business event, and handles external posting if configured.

methods.name: addPostBusinessEventListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for post-business events of a specific type.

methods.name: startExternalEventRecording
methods.description: Enables recording of external events for batching.

methods.name: stopExternalEventRecording
methods.description: Stops recording, and posts all recorded external events, either individually or as a bulk.

methods.name: resetEventRecording
methods.description: Resets the state related to event recording and clears recorded events.

methods.name: afterBegin
methods.description: Handles logic to initialize event collection at the start of a transaction.

methods.name: beforeCommit
methods.description: Handles post-processing logic before transaction commit, posting events to external service.

methods.name: afterCommit
methods.description: Cleans up after successful transaction commit.

methods.name: afterRollback
methods.description: Cleans up after a transaction rollback.
